counter_gap_note: The validator's `failed` counter (166) exceeds the itemized finding lines (157) by 9. Those 9 increment the counter without emitting a classifiable [FAIL]/[ERROR] line under a section heading, so no class can account for them. This gap is REAL and is why the previous record could not be reconciled: its `classes` summed to 172 against a `failed` of 163 — classes EXCEEDING the total, which is impossible if classes partition it, so that pair was never from one run. Both numbers here are from ONE run (see recorded_at_sha). Filed for v1.91: a gate that cannot show its work for 9 of its own findings is the misaimed-instrument class.

reason: Re-recorded 2026-08-21 by argus-a153 during the v1.90 ignition, at T48's consult and Mike's explicit word, because the previous pair was NOT INTERNALLY CONSISTENT and no one could reconcile it: `classes` summed to 172 against a `failed` of 163.
